evals.name: fresh-itk-build
evals.prompt: I need ITK v5.4.2 built as a shared library so I can use it with BRAINSTools via USE_SYSTEM_ITK. Set it up in common_support_versions.
evals.expected_output: Shell commands using skill scripts, ITK CMakeUserPresets.json with _shared suffix, and BRAINSTools consumer patch

assertions.text: BUILD_SHARED_LIBS is ON in the preset
No -D flags used on cmake command line
Consumer patch sets ITK_DIR pointing to installed_v5.4.2_shared

evals.name: asan-variant
evals.prompt: I already have ITK v5.4.2 in common_support_versions. Now I need an ASAN build of the same tag for sanitizer testing. Use the default Apple Clang compiler.
evals.expected_output: Commands for ASAN variant, preset with _asan suffix alongside existing default preset, ASAN flag notes

assertions.text: Uses _asan feature suffix (not _shared or no suffix)
Does NOT specify a non-default compiler (Apple Clang is system default)
Reuses existing src_v5.4.2 worktree (no new clone)
assertions.check: commands.sh does not clone a new repo or create a new worktree for the source

assertions.text: Build and install dirs have _asan suffix

assertions.check: itk_presets.json contains both csv_ITK_v5.4.2 and csv_ITK_v5.4.2_asan

evals.name: wire-consumer
evals.prompt: I've got ITK and VTK pre-built in common_support_versions. Update my BRAINSTools CMakeUserPresets.json to use them instead of the SuperBuild ExternalProjects.
evals.expected_output: Commands using csv_update_consumer.py for both ITK and VTK, resulting BRAINSTools presets, SuperBuild bypass notes

assertions.text: Sets ITK_DIR to correct cmake config path under installed_v5.4.2
Sets VTK_DIR to correct cmake config path under installed_v9.4.0

assertions.check: brainstools_presets.json contains both USE_SYSTEM variables set to ON

assertions.text: Mentions disabling SuperBuild EP for ITK/VTK
